title: refactor(rest): move registerUiEndpoints into ui-routes.ts (#23050 slice 10)
body:
Part of #23050
Clause-②: no

Slice 10 of the `rest-server.ts` split, by slice 1's pattern (landed note `6136102437`, steps 1–6), slice 2's getter refinement (`6189011700`) and slices 3–9's shape (slices 8 and 9: PR #23882, PR #23959). The body of `RestServer#registerUiEndpoints` (`GET {basePath}/ui/view/:object/:type`, the identity- and ownership-gated door onto the protocol's `getUiView`) moves to ONE new module, `packages/rest/src/ui-routes.ts`. The route table, the ordered registrations, every handler's source and digest, the published `dist/*.d.ts` and both bundles' export lists are byte-identical. Every reader whose reading included a moved line now reads it where it is, with its sum unchanged.

**No token of the body changed.** The body calls no class `static`, so the `static` exception (`6205442867`) is not used. It reads no provider field, so the provider ruling (`6215084478`) does not apply: nothing in the host is a getter. The ruled order of its guards is unchanged, byte for byte and at runtime (below).

**One module-level type moved with the body, by pattern step 5.** The body types its request through `TransportScopedMetaRequest`, a type alias declared in `rest-server.ts` and not exported. The claim says to export helpers from where they are declared. For a type alias, that changes the published `.d.ts` (measured below, twice), and slice 1's step 5 already rules for exactly this case: "A type alias moves with the body, because exporting one changes the `.d.ts`." So the alias block (its docblock and declaration, 40 lines) moved verbatim to `ui-routes.ts`, gaining only `export`. `rest-server.ts` imports it back for its 12 other typed uses. This mirrors slice 1's `ServerScopedDataRequest`. The alias's final home is asked as an open question in the report, as slice 1's was.

`rest-server.ts` goes from 9,995 to 9,915 lines (base `68ffa5dc1a`). The card stays open for the later slices; #23050 remains open after this PR.

## The pattern, applied

**Members the moved body reads**, from an AST walk of the method (TypeScript compiler API with a type checker, symbol-resolved, base `68ffa5dc1a`): `registerUiEndpoints` (JSDoc `:8284`, method `:8313`–`:8374`, body `:8314`–`:8373`, 60 lines).

| kind | member | reads | class declaration |
|---|---|---|---|
| field | `routeManager` | 1, the `register` call (`:8318`) | `:2026`, private |
| method | `resolveRequestEnvironmentId` | 1 (`:8329`) | `:2322`, private async |
| method | `resolveExecCtx` | 1 (`:8342`) | `:2872`, private async |
| method | `enforceAuth` | 1 (`:8343`) | `:2472`, private |
| method | `enforceEnvironmentOwnership` | 1 (`:8344`) | `:2597`, private |
| method | `resolveProtocol` | 1 (`:8345`) | `:2404`, private async |

The body has no bare `this`, no element access on `this`, no `function` keyword and no `RestServer.NAME` access. The seat's text count (the same six members, one read each) is confirmed.

**Control walk** (the same walker, same base): the `registerSearchEndpoints` stub (`:8999`) reads `routeManager`, `resolveProtocol`, `resolveExecCtx` and `enforceAuth` once each (slice 9's host literal). `enforceEnvironmentOwnership` itself (`:2597`) reads `extractProjectIdHeader` once, plus `ANONYMOUS_DENY_STATUS` and `ANONYMOUS_DENY_BODY` from `@objectstack/core`. Both match what their source says.

**Module-level reads** (the same walk):

- `handleRouteError` (`./error-response.js`): still used across `rest-server.ts`, so its import stays; the module imports the same name from the same module.
- `GetUiViewRequest` (type, `@objectstack/spec/api`): read ONLY by this body (2 hits in `rest-server.ts` at base: the import and this use). Its import name moved with the body, leaving a two-line pointer comment in the import block, as slice 6 did for `ErrorCode`.
- `TransportScopedMetaRequest` (declared `:299`): see above and the measurement below.

**Host shape (slice 1's shape B):** `UiRouteHost` (6 members) lists exactly the members the body reads, each typed `RestServer['m']`, in the body's read order. The class keeps the private method with its name, docblock and position. Its body is now a host literal plus `registerUiEndpoints.call(host, basePath)`. Methods go as late-bound closures, `(...a) => this.m(...a)`. The call site in `registerRoutes`' `registerForBase` (`this.registerUiEndpoints(bp);`, base `:4805`, head `:4772`, under `api.enableUi`) is unchanged: `registerRoutes` (75 lines) diffs to 0 between base and head.

**Fields, checked one by one:**

| field | read when | reassigned after registration? | handed over as |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routeManager` | registration only (one `register` call, a top-level statement of the body) | its one swap wraps `registerMetadataEndpointsInner`, not this registrar | value |

No other field is read. The environment, the caller, the ownership verdict and the protocol are each resolved per request by a method, so no getter is owed.

**Late binding and the guard order, measured** (a one-off vitest file, copied in, run under the verify lock, deleted; not committed). A source `RestServer` gets five instrumented members planted on the instance BEFORE `registerRoutes()`, and the door is driven. Then five new ones are planted AFTER registration, and the door is driven again. Each member records its call.

- **Head:** `MEASURE before: 200 {"answeredBy":"early",…} | order early:env,early:ctx,early:auth,early:own,early:proto` and `MEASURE after: 200 {"answeredBy":"late","env":"env_late",…} | order late:env,late:ctx,late:auth,late:own,late:proto | early calls after re-plant 5`. Result: `Tests 1 passed (1)`. The members reached are the late ones, in the ruled order (resolve the environment once, resolve identity in it, refuse anonymity, compare ownership, then resolve the protocol).
- **Ablation** through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the host literal's `enforceEnvironmentOwnership: (...a) => this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership(...a),` was replaced by `enforceEnvironmentOwnership: this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership.bind(this),`. Anchor 1 → 0; blob `b429a90b19d3` → `97583add2404`.
  - Result: `order late:env,late:ctx,late:auth,late:proto`, with the early guard called a sixth time, and `Tests 1 failed (1)`.
  - Restored by the tool: blob `b429a90b19d3` equals `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **Base leg:** the base `rest-server.ts` (blob `1c7f7e45a921`) was restored into the tree under a trap, then `git checkout HEAD` with blob and diff proof. The answers are the same as the head's, and `Tests 1 passed (1)`.

## Proof of move-only

- **Moved body:** base `rest-server.ts` lines 8314–8373, with one 4-space indent removed, against `ui-routes.ts` lines 118–177. `diff` exits 0 over the 60 lines.
  - Every non-empty line of the range carries the method indent. The range has one empty line and no trailing whitespace.
  - Every line with a backtick holds an even number of them, so no template literal spans the cut.
- **Moved alias block:** base `rest-server.ts` lines 260–299 against `ui-routes.ts` lines 54–93. `diff` exits 0 once the `export ` keyword on the last line is set aside. A `//` note above it says why it moved, and that the block's "here" and "this file" still mean `rest-server.ts`, where the doors it describes live.
- **The private method's docblock and signature** (base `:8284`–`:8313`, head `:8251`–`:8280`) diff to 0.
- **`.d.ts`:** `packages/rest/dist/index.d.ts` and `index.d.cts` were built at base `68ffa5dc1a` (before any edit), at the merge head `5da02e4b9`, and again after the whole-workspace build.
  - All are byte-identical: sha256 `7489de84bc6feccb7cb1f28bcbe4a97775324959c61c9bfc35e8a8c45a6f3bc9`.
  - The head bundles carry a head-only marker (`registerUiEndpoints.call`: 1 hit in each of `index.js` and `index.cjs`, 0 at base), so the declaration was rebuilt from the moved source, not replayed.
  - `src/index.ts` is untouched.
- **Why the alias could not be exported in place** (both measured, each through `ablation-replace.mjs`, restored by blob and diff proof, and rebuilt back to `7489de84…`):
  - `export type TransportScopedMetaRequest…` at its declaration gives `dist/index.d.ts` sha256 `a82fe845e80c…`: line 1625, a blank line, disappears.
  - a separate `export type { TransportScopedMetaRequest };` statement gives the same `a82fe845e80c…` and the same one-line change.
  - Slice 1 measured this for `ServerScopedDataRequest`. Moving the alias, by contrast, leaves the `.d.ts` byte-identical (above).
  - The first attempt at the first counterfactual was a no-op: its anchor was a substring of its replacement, the tool refused it, and nothing ran. It was re-anchored and re-run.
- **Export lists:** the base and head ESM and CJS bundles each load with 39 exports and one sorted export-name list (sha256 `b3246be6a1718700…` on all four). No UI-module name is among them.
- **Routes:** a source `RestServer` runs on a recording mock server, with a protocol that answers every member. It is dumped under slice 9's eight configs plus a ninth, `enableUi: false` under scoped-optional, the door's own switch. The eight are: default; scoped-optional; scoped-required; every provider set; `enableDiscovery: false`; `enableOpenApi: false`; both off under scoped-optional; `enableSearch: false` under scoped-optional.
  - Each dump holds four files: `getRoutes()` (functions as arity); the ordered server registration calls; a whitespace-free sha256 of every handler's source; and that source.
  - **36 of 36 dump files are byte-identical**, base `68ffa5dc1a` vs merge head `5da02e4b9` (`diff -r` exits 0). A second base run was identical to the first.
  - Route counts: default 75 (1 UI door); scoped-optional 150 (2); scoped-required 75 (1); every-provider-set equal to default; discovery-off 73 (1); openapi-off 73 (1); both-off-scoped-optional 142 (2); search-off-scoped-optional 148 (2); ui-off-scoped-optional 148 (0).
  - The default config's routes and calls digests (`6931d1a5d182…` / `ccb3bd12f10b…`) are the ones slices 5–9 reported for it.
  - Because no token changed, every handler digest is identical with no mapping.
- **The handler digest can fail:** a positive control added one character to the moved handler (`'…protocol implementation'` → `'…protocol implementation!'`, through `ablation-replace.mjs`; anchor 1 → 0, blob `2eab547e5bba` → `1d0809727b0b`).
  - Routes and calls were unchanged in all nine configs.
  - The handler digests differed in exactly the UI door of each mounted base: `GET /api/v1/ui/view/:object/:type`, and `GET /api/v1/environments/:environmentId/ui/view/:object/:type` where scoped. Nothing else differed, and nothing differed under `enableUi: false`.
  - Restored: blob `2eab547e5bba` equals `HEAD`.

## Readers re-pointed (sums unchanged, no gate loosened)

`packages/rest/src/rest-server-registrar-files.ts` gains `ui-routes.ts` with a `[#23050 slice 10]` comment (length 10 → 11). Every reader that pins its length re-reads its number:

| `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` | 62 sites = 22 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 | the UI site is BARE and guarded on its next line, as before (46 bare / 16 caught unchanged). Mentions 121 → 125, the seam once (forwarder ×2 in `rest-server.ts`, interface member ×2 in the module); `rest-server.ts` 59 → 60. Forwarders 12 = (11 − 1) + 3 − 1; neither map gains an entry |
| `ui-view-route-identity.measurement.test.ts` | `this.enforceAuth(` 59, `this.resolveExecCtx(` 74 over the list (58 / 73 before, +1 each for the UI literal's forwarders; floors 40 hold) | the sliced reading is re-pointed (below); length 10 → 11 |
| `ui-view-route-tenancy.measurement.test.ts` | as above; the ownership guard's call sites: 1 | the sliced reading and the ownership pin are re-pointed (below); length 10 → 11 |
| dogfood `authz-conformance.test.ts` (realtime tripwires) | 0 hits over the eleven files | length 10 → 11 |
| dogfood `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`, `rest-server.ts` row | 70 / 19 / 51 unchanged; `this.routeManager.register(` 63 = 20 + 9 + 5 + 7 + 8 + 1 + 6 + 4 + 1 + 1 + 1; `private register*Endpoints(` 16 | new control `ui-routes.ts: this.routeManager.register(` 1; `registrar list length` 11; `enforceAuth` 104 → 108 re-anchored (the one call site moved and is counted in both readings; the four new occurrences are the seam once; no call site added); `populationRule` names the new module |

**The two ui-view measurement tests read this body directly, so they are re-pointed with care.**

- **The sliced reading.** Both tests sliced `rest-server.ts` from `private registerUiEndpoints(` to `private registerCrudEndpoints(`. That span is now the host literal, whose forwarders spell `this.enforceAuth(`, `this.resolveExecCtx(`, `this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership(` and `this.resolveProtocol(` in the very order the tenancy test asserts, while calling none of them in a route. A slice there would pass the order assertions vacuously.
  - Both tests now slice `ui-routes.ts`, from `export function registerUiEndpoints(` to the function's own closing brace (the first column-0 brace after it), so neither the module header nor a later declaration can satisfy it.
  - Every `toContain` and every order assertion is unchanged. That the private method still mounts this one route is held, as before, by the identity test's §6 runtime attribution (`byRegistrar.get('registerUiEndpoints')` equals the one UI route).
- **The ownership pin.** `this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership(` over the list was pinned at exactly 1, "a single new call site plus its definition". Over the eleven files the spelling now reads 2: the one call site, which moved to `ui-routes.ts`, plus this slice's host-literal forwarder.
  - The pin now asserts both halves exactly: forwarders (`(...a) => this.enforceEnvironmentOwnership(...a)`) `toBe(1)`, and call sites (spellings minus forwarders) `toBe(1)`.
  - The call-site count is unchanged at 1, and a second forwarder reds as loudly as a second call site. Nothing is loosened.

Readers outside the list:

- `scripts/check-route-envelope.mjs` (a gate's target paths, `domain:spec`): `ui-routes.ts` is declared `dialectOnly` with ratchet #9559, as the nine earlier modules are, at its measured `stringError 1` / `siblingCode 1`. Its one hand-built refusal is the 501 `{ error: 'UI View resolution not supported by protocol implementation', code: 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED' }`.
  - `rest-server.ts` drops by exactly that body: `stringError` 16 → 15 and `siblingCode` 14 → 13, each recorded as "NOT progress — the same MOVE".
  - The sums are unchanged: 15 + 13 + 8 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 1 + 0 + 1 = 39, and 13 + 15 + 8 + 9 + 4 + 1 + 0 + 0 + 3 + 0 + 1 = 54.
  - Its output differs from `origin/main` only in the `rest-server.ts` row and the new row (20 → 21 modules, 11 → 12 ratcheted). `--self-test` is green.
- No new ADR anchor: neither moved range cites an `ADR-NNNN Dk`. `check-adr-anchors` output is identical at `origin/main` and head (1770 decision-letter citations).
- No platform-checklist anchor names the UI registrar or the alias; `check:platform-checklist` output is identical at `origin/main` and head.

**Red before the re-points**, each measured with the move in place (`9c34e1a99`, the readers at their base text):

- `@objectstack/rest` `local` read `Test Files 6 failed | 281 passed (287)` and `Tests 7 failed | 5895 passed | 326 skipped (6228)`. The failures were the four length pins (execctx, meta-draft, query-number, docblock), the docblock pin's unfloored new module, and both ui-view sliced readings: `expected 'private registerUiEndpoints(basePath:…' to contain 'p.getUiView('`, and the same for `const isScoped = …`.
- `rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts` (`repo`) read `Tests 2 failed | 248 passed | 11 skipped (261)`.
- The dogfood pair read `Tests 2 failed | 106 passed (108)`: the realtime tripwire's length pin, and `control "registrar list length" moved … expected 11 to be 10`.
- `check:route-envelope` read `ui-routes.ts NOT DECLARED`, plus `rest-server.ts` `stringError: found 15, declared 16` and `siblingCode: found 13, declared 14`.
- Each is green after the re-point. The tenancy test stopped at its first failing `toContain`, so its exact ownership pin was not observed red in that run. It was counted directly instead: 1 spelling at base, 2 at the move commit (1 call site plus 1 forwarder).

## Readers examined and not re-pointed

- **`packages/spec` (stopped at, per the dispatch, not edited):** no reader there includes a moved line. `packages/spec/liveness/rest_api.json` cites `rest-server.ts#registerRoutes` for the `if (this.config.api.enableUi)` gate, the call site that did not move. Its second citation is `registerDiscoveryEndpoints`, slice 7's. `packages/spec` names `TransportScopedMetaRequest` in comments as living in `packages/rest` (e.g. `protocol.zod.ts`), never by file, and it still does. `check:liveness` output is identical at `origin/main` and head.

The same holds for `data-action-routes.ts`' `{@link TransportScopedMetaRequest}`, which resolves by name exactly as it did before.

## Acceptance notes

- `objectql-slot-consumer-census.test.ts` (slice 8's extra reader) is not touched: the UI body reads no provider slot, and it stays green.
- The moved `[commit cc837dbfe]` comments in the body still read true in the module: they describe the handler they sit in, and name `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts` by file, which still counts this site.
- The moved alias block's prose ("the doors here", "call sites in this file") describes `rest-server.ts`, where those doors live; the note above it in `ui-routes.ts` says so rather than editing the moved text.
